quarterly_data.signal: Nidec disclosed the redacted Executive Responsibility Investigation Committee report on October 20, 2026 (only a Japanese digest so far). The report excluded the appropriation of surplus from the investigation because Nidec had not submitted amended securities reports for past fiscal years before the report, making the past distributable amount uncertain; Nidec says it will act on the responsibility in this matter by examining necessary legal actions such as filing a lawsuit, after completing the correction of past fiscal years' financial statements.
